Need to talk to someone?

Some parts of this course cover hard topics. If something here, or something in your life, is getting to you, you don't have to cope alone.

  • At school or college: your tutor or the Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL).
  • Childline (under 19): 0800 1111. Free, 24 hours.
  • Samaritans: 116 123. Free, 24 hours.
  • Shout: text SHOUT to 85258. Free, 24 hours.
  • In danger now? Call 999.

Nothing you type in this hub is read by anyone. If you want to tell someone something, use one of the contacts above or speak to a member of staff.

Text size

Some cases and questions in this hub cover abuse, self-harm, suicide, bullying, dementia and mental ill health. They are factual, with no detail about methods. You can skip any of them. If a topic upsets you, help is listed above.

Built from the Pearson BTEC Level 3 National Extended Diploma in Health and Social Care specification (Issue 10, June 2022). Default exam grade boundaries are from Pearson's June 2026 series. Boundaries change every series, so treat the points from raw marks as estimates. Your teacher's assessment decisions and Pearson's results are what count.

No names, no tracking and no outside requests. Your writing isn't saved unless you turn that on. Ticks, ratings and quiz progress are kept in this browser and, if you're signed in to Claude, privately in your own account. Saved progress is deleted after 12 months without use, and you can delete it any time. See Planner → Your privacy.
